amber.basis: Fossil resin modeled with the approximate empirical formula C₁₀H₁₆O; an amorphous polymer mixture, not a defined compound or crystal.

adamant.basis: Oritech foundry/alloy/adamant uses one nickel ingot and one diamond. The shaped adamant_ingot recipe uses two of each. Fragment forge and pulverizer produce one dust per ingot, and smelting reverses that conversion.

advanced_alloy.basis: Energized Power alloy_furnace/advanced_alloy_ingot consumes three steel, three copper and three tin ingots. Only copper and tin are recovered across the interchangeable steel and Biosteel inputs.

andesite.basis: Simplified oxide composition on the common stone scale. Variants and reviewed mod forms share this ratio.

aquarine_copper.basis: Nautec mixes three copper with brine and kelp into six compounds. Purification can yield four ingots per compound, so only one eighth of a copper ingot is recovered per ingot.

awakened_supremium_essence.basis: Recovery only. Awakening requires Cognizant Dust from the Wither or the Ender Dragon and the Awakening Altar.

awakened_supremium_gemstone.basis: One Prosperity base and two exact-tier native ingredients. Higher tier essence is distinct from the lower tiers. The finished Awakened or Insanium material remains native manufacture only.

awakened_supremium_metal.basis: One Prosperity base and two exact-tier native ingredients. Higher tier essence is distinct from the lower tiers. The finished Awakened or Insanium material remains native manufacture only.

azurite.basis: The one-ingot native recipe consumes two Nuclear Waste and one Lapis Lazuli. Recover the identifiable lapis input only. Alternate fuel and waste are excluded from synthesis. The storage block is nine ingots.

basalt.basis: Simplified mafic oxide composition on the common stone scale of 3,000 units per block. Variants and reviewed mod forms share this ratio.

biosteel.basis: Oritech foundry/alloy/biosteel consumes one iron ingot and raw biopolymer. Its biomass and water routes do not yet have a shared biopolymer profile. Recovery is limited to iron.

blackstone.basis: Simplified oxide composition on the common stone scale. Variants and reviewed mod forms share this ratio.

blazegold.basis: Tier-two Goo turns one gold block into ore that drops three to four raw pieces. FTB Industrial Contraptions refines one raw piece into five ingots, so one block yields up to twenty ingots. Each ingot recovers one twentieth of the block and each raw piece five ingots. The native Goo tier still makes the material.

blue_ice.basis: All ice stores solid H2O. Vanilla compresses ice and packed ice at 9:1, but FTBIC and Refurbished Furniture also compress both grades at 1:1. Recovery uses the lowest shared yield. Compressed grades still require their native recipes.

brass.basis: Shared brass tags permit brand exchange. Infinity Nexus makes three brass ingots from one copper and one zinc, and three brass blocks from one copper block and one nickel block. Thaumaturge uses copper and Instrumentum without zinc. Three brass recover exactly the common 1,000 copper.

bronze.basis: AllTheOres, FTB Industrial Contraptions and Infinity Nexus use three copper plus one tin for four bronze. Mekanism processing/bronze/ingot/from_infusing and dust/from_infusing use ten tin chemical for four; one tin dust supplies eighty chemical via enriching/enriched/tin and chemical_conversion/tin/from_enriched. Four bronze therefore recover exactly 3,000 copper and 125 tin, the cheaper route.

calcite.basis: Shared mineral and essence constituents. Supported blocks and powders use exact processing ratios.

conductive_alloy.basis: One exact share of the verified Ender IO alloy smelting batch.

constantan.basis: One copper and one nickel yield two Constantan.

corrupted_arcane_crystal.basis: Recovery only. Corrupted Arcane Crystal is Forbidden Arcanus progression material; its native corruption stays required.

corrupti.basis: Four Corrupti Dust share the verified metal constituents of one Stygian Steel, one Arcane Crystal Dust and one quarter-pearl fragment. Two dusts recover exactly half of them. Blaze powder and Nether Wart stay in the native recipe.

dark_steel.basis: One exact share of the verified Ender IO alloy smelting batch.

deepslate.basis: Simplified oxide composition on the common stone scale. Variants and reviewed mod forms share this ratio.

deorum.basis: One Deorum uses eighteen molten gold and thirty-six molten Arcane Crystal. The Clibano yields nine units per source item, so the ingot requires two gold and four Arcane Crystals. Recovery only. Deorum is Forbidden Arcanus progression material; its native Clibano alloying stays required.

desh.basis: Stellaris smelts one raw Desh per ingot and compacts nine into one block. The recipes do not specify constituents. Existing recoveries are ReMatter’s nominal gameplay model. ReMatter models one ingot as 550 iron, 250 titanium and 200 Stellar Essence.

diorite.basis: Simplified oxide composition on the common stone scale. Variants and reviewed mod forms share this ratio.

dragonyst.basis: Recover two amethyst dusts and one crushed End Stone from the verified ritual inputs. End Crystals, Dragon Breath and the Marid ritual remain required for production.

duratium.basis: Oritech foundry/alloy/duratium uses platinum and netherite. Oritech atomicforge/duratium instead uses platinum and two reinforced carbon sheets. Platinum is their only verified common input.

echo.basis: Recovery only. Echo shards are Ancient City loot, and Occultism converts echo dust and shards one to one, so synthesis would release special loot.

eclipsealloy.basis: Tier-four Goo turns one Netherite block into ore that drops three to four raw pieces. FTB Industrial Contraptions refines one raw piece into five ingots, so one block yields up to twenty ingots. Each ingot recovers one twentieth of the block and each raw piece five ingots. The native Goo tier still makes the material.

electrum.basis: AllTheOres and FTB Industrial Contraptions alloy one gold and one silver into two. Oritech foundry/alloy/electrum uses gold and redstone instead. AllTheOres crafting/electrum/block_to_ingot and crafting/hammer/electrum/dust_from_ingot convert through common tags. Only gold is common to the two origins.

ember.basis: Applied Generators produces Ember with Fluix, gunpowder, blaze powder and lava. The cheapest demonstrated batch produces 64 from 16 of each solid input. Growth and the charged crystal routes stay distinct from the ReMatter recovery model.

end_steel.basis: One exact share of the verified Ender IO alloy smelting batch.

end_stone.basis: Shared mineral and essence constituents. Supported blocks and powders use exact processing ratios.

ender_pearl.basis: Shared mineral and essence constituents. Supported blocks and powders use exact processing ratios.

enderium.basis: Shared tags exchange Enderium made with platinum in AllTheOres and Enderium made with diamond in FTB Industrial Contraptions. Recover only the lead and pearl constituents common to both recipes.

energetic_alloy.basis: One exact share of the verified Ender IO alloy smelting batch.

energite.basis: Oritech foundry/alloy/energite and compat/powah/energizing/energite both consume one nickel ingot and one fluxite. The charged Fluxite material is retained in the alloy profile.

entro.basis: ExtendedAE grows Entro crystals and repairs Entro dust using Fluix. The stored crystal state is a ReMatter model and the native growth or repair route is required.

ferricore.basis: Tier-one Goo turns one iron block into ore that drops three to four raw pieces. FTB Industrial Contraptions refines one raw piece into five ingots, so one block yields up to twenty ingots. Each ingot recovers one twentieth of the block and each raw piece five ingots. The native Goo tier still makes the material.

fluix.basis: AE2 uses charged Certus, Nether Quartz and Redstone. AdvancedAE and Applied Generators make 64 Fluix from 16 of each, and their Fluix Dust duplication routes omit Redstone and Nether Quartz. Recover at most 250 units of Certus per Fluix. Charging, duplication and growth use native recipes.

fluxite.basis: Oritech recipes can produce fluxite by charging amethyst, lasing an amethyst cluster, processing platinum, or colliding electrum dust and redstone. They share no verified recoverable ingredient. The charged material remains intact.

glowstone.basis: Shared mineral and essence constituents. Supported blocks and powders use exact processing ratios.

granite.basis: Simplified oxide composition on the common stone scale. Variants and reviewed mod forms share this ratio.

hexsteel.basis: Hextale alloying/hexsteel_ingot uses one iron and two Hextech dusts with the coal or charcoal tag. Iron and Hextech are recovered; the alternative fuel inputs are omitted.

hextech.basis: Hextale provides separate crystal and dust items. Hextale 1.9.0 has no data recipe establishing free reversibility, so both forms retain the Hextech material without a ReMatter output.

iesnium.basis: Occultism obtains this mineral from native Iesnium ore, then refines it. The shared constituents are a ReMatter model. Native acquisition remains required.

imperium_gemstone.basis: One Prosperity base and two exact-tier native ingredients. Higher tier essence is distinct from the lower tiers.

imperium_metal.basis: One Prosperity base and two exact-tier native ingredients. Higher tier essence is distinct from the lower tiers.

inferium_essence.basis: The common-tag furnace route yields one. Mining stays the native higher-yield route.

inferium_gemstone.basis: One Prosperity base and two exact-tier native ingredients. Higher tier essence is distinct from the lower tiers.

inferium_metal.basis: One Prosperity base and two exact-tier native ingredients. Higher tier essence is distinct from the lower tiers.

infinity.basis: Infinity Nexus mines native Infinity ore and refines it. Crushing and reversible storage recipes preserve the batch. The mineral constituents are a ReMatter model and production requires the native mineral.

insanium_essence.basis: Recovery only. Insanium is a top Mystical Agriculture tier; its native upgrade, awakening or seed progression stays required.

insanium_gemstone.basis: One Prosperity base and two exact-tier native ingredients. Higher tier essence is distinct from the lower tiers. The finished Awakened or Insanium material remains native manufacture only.

insanium_metal.basis: One Prosperity base and two exact-tier native ingredients. Higher tier essence is distinct from the lower tiers. The finished Awakened or Insanium material remains native manufacture only.

insulating_resin.basis: Applied Flux makes resin from Glowstone Dust, organic ingredients and #c:silicon. Applied Generators synthesizer/insulating_resin uses ae2:silicon without glowstone, and synthesizer/insulating_resin_duplicate turns 32 resin, 32 silicon and 32 sky dust into 64. Every route shares only one silicon item per resin, so each resin recovers 250 silicon. Firing changes the resin state.

invar.basis: AllTheOres and FTB Industrial Contraptions make three Invar from two iron and one nickel. Oritech compat/ato/foundry/alloy/invar makes two from one iron and one nickel. Recovery keeps the smaller amount of each element, 500 iron and one third of a nickel per invar, so three invar recover exactly 1,500 iron and 1,000 nickel. These minima undercut every single native route, so synthesis is disabled.

lumium.basis: Three tin, one silver and four glowstone dust yield four Lumium. The glowstone contributes silica and Cinderium.

mundabitur.basis: Four Mundabitur Dust share one Arcane Crystal Dust and one redstone. The other crafting reagents remain required by the native recipe.

naquadah.basis: Mekanism Extras obtains raw Naquadah from its ores. Native smelting uses one ore or raw Naquadah per ingot. The constituent split is a ReMatter model and synthesis cannot replace the native ore route. ReMatter models one ingot as 600 uranium and 400 Stellar Essence.

natural_ice.basis: All ice stores solid H2O. Vanilla compresses ice and packed ice at 9:1, but FTBIC and Refurbished Furniture also compress both grades at 1:1. Recovery uses the lowest shared yield. Compressed grades still require their native recipes.

neptunium.basis: Aquaculture supplies Neptunium through Neptune’s Bounty fishing loot. Equipment smelting and reversible storage retain Neptunium. The constituent split is a ReMatter model and synthesis cannot replace fishing. ReMatter models one ingot as 150 gold, 650 iron and 200 Vital Essence.

netherite.basis: Native routes differ: vanilla uses four gold ingots and four Netherite Scrap, FTB Industrial Contraptions alloy_smelting/netherite_ingot two of each, Oritech foundry/alloy/netherite one of each, and Mekanism processing/netherite/scrap_to_dust four scrap with forty gold chemical, one eighth of a gold dust. Recovery keeps the smallest amount of each element: 500 gold and 1,000 Netherium. These minima undercut every native route, so synthesis is disabled.

netherite_scrap.basis: Netherite Scrap is an ore-derived base material like diamond, not loot or a boss item. Its Netherium only enters storage by decomposing debris-derived items, so synthesis is a one-to-one round trip.

netherrack.basis: Shared mineral and essence constituents. Supported blocks and powders use exact processing ratios.

novite.basis: Stellaris smelts one raw Novite per ingot and compacts nine into one block. The recipes do not specify constituents. Existing recoveries are ReMatter’s nominal gameplay model.

obsidian.basis: Shared mineral constituents. Four dusts contain one block. Only the natural block can be synthesized, because Occultism gray_paste/obsidian and crystallize/obsidian turn one dust into a whole block.

occultism_witherite.basis: Three Witherite Dust share one Netherite Dust and one crushed Blackstone. The Wither Skeleton Skull, Wither Rose and Afrit ritual remain required for production.

packed_ice.basis: All ice stores solid H2O. Vanilla compresses ice and packed ice at 9:1, but FTBIC and Refurbished Furniture also compress both grades at 1:1. Recovery uses the lowest shared yield. Compressed grades still require their native recipes.

plastic.basis: Oritech does not specify a polymer. ReMatter models finished plastic as polyethylene (C2H4)n and recovers carbon and molecular hydrogen. Oritech centrifuge/fluid/plasticbiobetter turns one polymer resin into four sheets, so a sheet recovers one quarter of a resin. A block packs exactly nine sheets.

polymer_resin.basis: One resin equals four plastic sheets, the best native yield of Oritech centrifuge/fluid/plasticbiobetter; the furnace and water centrifuge routes yield fewer sheets and lose material. The resin itself stands for its unprofiled naphtha, biodiesel or biomass feedstock, a renewable organic source.

prometheum.basis: Oritech atomicforge/prometheum consumes a Heisenberg Compensator and two Overcharged Crystals. Both compensator recipes use two adamant ingots. Recovery follows those two verified common ingots; the remaining components are excluded.

prosperity_essence.basis: The common-tag furnace route yields one. Mining stays the native higher-yield route.

prosperity_gemstone.basis: One iron ingot or diamond and four Prosperity Shards supply the native base.

prosperity_metal.basis: One iron ingot or diamond and four Prosperity Shards supply the native base.

prudentium_gemstone.basis: One Prosperity base and two exact-tier native ingredients. Higher tier essence is distinct from the lower tiers.

prudentium_metal.basis: One Prosperity base and two exact-tier native ingredients. Higher tier essence is distinct from the lower tiers.

pulsating_alloy.basis: Ender IO alloy_smelting/pulsating_alloy_ingot and FTB Industrial Contraptions alloy_smelting/enderio_pulsating_alloy_ingot use one iron and one ender pearl for two ingots.

radiant_alloy.basis: Hextale 1.9.0 alloying/radiant_alloy_ingot uses two gold, one charged Hexsteel and two gemstone dusts for two ingots. Gold is the verified portion; the charged and gemstone inputs are excluded.

redstone.basis: Shared mineral and essence constituents. Supported blocks and powders use exact processing ratios.

redstone_alloy.basis: Ender IO alloy_smelting/redstone_alloy_ingot uses one copper and one redstone. Energized Power alloy_furnace/redstone_alloy_ingot uses tin, silicon and two redstone. The shared material profiles recover only one redstone batch.

refined_glowstone.basis: Recovers the original mineral constituents. Osmium is a machine reagent and direct synthesis is disabled.

refined_obsidian.basis: Recovers the original mineral constituents. Osmium is a machine reagent and direct synthesis is disabled.

refined_obsidian_precursor.basis: One obsidian dust with 10 diamond chemical units. Eight batches use one enriched diamond.

replica.basis: Replication smelts one raw Replica to one ingot and compresses nine ingots into a block. Its native mineral has no recipe-defined composition. The constituent split is a ReMatter model and production requires the native mineral. ReMatter models one ingot as 600 silicon and 400 Quantum Essence.

riftmetal.basis: Hextale 1.9.0 alloying/riftmetal_ingot uses one Radiant Alloy and two raw Riftmetal. Recovery includes the verified gold portion of Radiant Alloy; the ore and charged-material constituents are unspecified.

signalum.basis: Three copper, one silver and four redstone dust yield four Signalum. The redstone contributes silica and Arcane Essence.

silicon.basis: FTBIC separates one quartz into three Silicon Gems. AE2, Energized Power, ExtendedAE, FTBIC, Oritech and other mods share #c:silicon; storage recipes exchange brands. Oritech yields four silicon per sand with silicon wash, and ExtendedAE yields 24 from a blend batch using six sand and additional quartz. Recover 250 silicon units per exchangeable item so the sand routes stay within the accounted silicon input.

soularium.basis: Ender IO alloy_smelting/soularium_ingot uses one gold plus either soul sand or soul soil. Only the gold input has a reviewed shared constituent profile.

soulium_gemstone.basis: One Prosperity base and two Soulium Dust. The finished Soulium material remains native manufacture only.

soulium_metal.basis: One Prosperity base and two Soulium Dust. The finished Soulium material remains native manufacture only.

stainless_steel.basis: The largest native batch makes seven stainless steel from two steel ingots plus modifiers. Seven ingots recover exactly the 2,000 iron of that steel; optional additives are excluded. Native alloying remains required.

stellarum.basis: Infinity Nexus fermentation/infinity_stelarium_ingot transforms one Infinity Ingot with Starliquid Water. Only the conserved material from that ingot is recovered.

stygian_steel.basis: One Stygian Steel uses four copper, two gold, two iron and four Asterite chunks. Recover the three verified metals and keep Asterite processing in the Clibano.

supremium_essence.basis: Recovery only. Supremium is a top Mystical Agriculture tier; its native upgrade, awakening or seed progression stays required.

tertium_metal.basis: One Prosperity base and two exact-tier native ingredients. Higher tier essence is distinct from the lower tiers.

tuff.basis: Simplified oxide composition on the common stone scale. Variants and reviewed mod forms share this ratio.
